```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(flextable); library(stringr) })
SAI <- "saidas"; FIG <- "figuras_en"
rd <- function(f, ...) read.csv(file.path(SAI, f), encoding = "UTF-8", ...)
ex <- function(f) file.exists(file.path(SAI, f))
f <- function(x, d = 1) { x <- as.numeric(x); ifelse(is.na(x), "—", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d, big.mark = ",", decimal.mark = ".")) }
n0 <- function(x) formatC(round(as.numeric(x)), format = "d", big.mark = ",")
ic <- function(r, l, h, d = 2) paste0(f(r, d), "; 95% CI ", f(l, d), "–", f(h, d))
icx <- function(x, d = 2) ic(if ("irr" %in% names(x)) x$irr else x$rr, x$lo, x$hi, d)
pv <- function(p) if (is.na(p)) "NA" else if (p < 0.001) "< 0.001" else paste0("= ", f(p, 3))
sig <- function(l, h) isTRUE(l > 1 | h < 1)
pct <- function(r) f(100 * abs(r - 1), 0)
meses <- month.name
mes_ano <- function(d) { d <- as.Date(d); if (is.na(d)) "—" else paste(meses[as.integer(format(d, "%m"))], format(d, "%Y")) }

fl <- rd("fluxograma.csv"); N <- setNames(fl$n, fl$etapa); g <- function(p) N[grep(p, names(N))][1]
conf <- rd("confirmacao_por_ano.csv")
tt <- rd("taxa_anual_total.csv"); tf <- rd("taxa_anual_faixa.csv"); tr <- rd("taxa_anual_regiao.csv")
JP <- "principal"; INI <- as.Date("2024-07-01"); FIM <- as.Date("2025-12-01")
tc <- rd("tercis_resumo.csv"); TC <- function(e, k) tc[tc$exposicao == e, ][grep(k, tc$categoria[tc$exposicao == e], fixed = TRUE), ]
nesf <- if (file.exists("dados/processados/aps_mun.rds")) table(as.character(readRDS("dados/processados/aps_mun.rds")$cat_aps)) else NULL
rr <- rd("rr_principal_vs_ref.csv"); rrm <- rd("rr_mensal_2024.csv"); dc <- rd("decomposicao_excesso_principal.csv")
RRJ <- function(j) rd(paste0("rr_", j, "_vs_ref.csv"))
# painel mensal: observado/esperado mês a mês e taxas no período
pm <- readRDS("dados/processados/painel_mensal.rds")
tx_ref <- pm |> filter(ano %in% 2016:2019) |> group_by(faixa, regiao, mes) |> summarise(tx = sum(casos) / sum(pop), .groups = "drop")
oe_mes <- pm |> filter(ano %in% 2024:2025) |> left_join(tx_ref, by = c("faixa", "regiao", "mes")) |>
  group_by(data) |> summarise(obs = sum(casos), esp = sum(tx * pop), .groups = "drop") |> mutate(oe = obs / esp)
oe_inicio <- min(oe_mes$data[oe_mes$oe > 1]); oe_fim <- max(oe_mes$data[oe_mes$oe > 1 & oe_mes$data < as.Date("2025-07-01")])
oe_pico <- oe_mes |> slice_max(oe, n = 1)
OE <- function(d) oe_mes$oe[oe_mes$data == as.Date(d)]
na_janela <- pm |> filter(data >= INI, data <= FIM)
n_meses <- length(unique(na_janela$data))
cn <- rd("cobertura_nacional_ponderada.csv"); cr <- rd("cobertura_resumo_municipal.csv")
uf <- rd("uf_correlacoes.csv"); dv <- rd("denominador_vs_censo.csv")
md_all <- rd("modelos_cobertura_excesso.csv"); md <- md_all |> filter(ano_alvo == JP)
R <- function(e, n, x = rr) x |> filter(estrato == e, nivel == n)
D <- function(e, n, x = dc) x |> filter(estrato == e, nivel == n)
M <- function(gr, ex, mo, te = NULL, x = md) { y <- x |> filter(grupo == gr, exposicao == ex, modelo == mo); if (!is.null(te)) y <- y |> filter(termo == te); y }
EXD <- "Variação da DTP"; EXN <- "Não vacinados 2019–2023"; EXT <- "dTpa 2023–2024"

# magnitude e distribuição
tot <- R("Total", "< 5 anos"); ex_tot <- sum(dc$excesso[dc$estrato == "Regiao"])
esp_tot <- sum(dc$esp[dc$estrato == "Regiao"]); obs_tot <- sum(dc$obs[dc$estrato == "Regiao"])
f1 <- D("Semestre", "s2_2024"); f2 <- D("Semestre", "s1_2025"); f3 <- D("Semestre", "s2_2025"); lab <- R("Criterio", "lab"); nlab <- R("Criterio", "nlab")
pct_lab_ref <- with(conf |> filter(ano %in% 2016:2019), 100 * sum(lab) / sum(conf))
inv <- rrm |> filter(faixa == "total", lo > 1) |> pull(mes)
mx <- rrm |> filter(faixa == "total") |> slice_max(rr, n = 1)
taxa <- function(a) tt$taxa[tt$ano == a]
taxa_jan <- 1e5 * sum(na_janela$casos) / (sum(na_janela$pop) / 12)
taxa_de_ref <- with(tt |> filter(ano %in% 2016:2019), 1e5 * sum(casos) / sum(pa))
pico_hist <- tt |> filter(ano < 2020) |> slice_max(taxa, n = 1)
reg_menos <- dc |> filter(estrato == "Regiao", excesso < 0) |> pull(nivel)

# 2025
tem25 <- TRUE
rr24a <- RRJ("ano_2024"); rr25 <- RRJ("ano_2025"); rrjd <- RRJ("jul_dez_2024")
rr2425 <- RRJ("ano_2024_2025"); tot2425 <- R("Total", "< 5 anos", rr2425)
tot24a <- R("Total", "< 5 anos", rr24a); tot25 <- R("Total", "< 5 anos", rr25); totjd <- R("Total", "< 5 anos", rrjd)
MJ <- function(j, gr, e, mo = "e_continua_regiao_ano") M(gr, e, mo, x = md_all |> filter(ano_alvo == j))

# detecção e momento da onda (06c)
tem_det <- ex("deteccao_por_regiao.csv")
if (tem_det) { det <- rd("deteccao_por_regiao.csv"); DT <- function(r, p) det |> filter(regiao == r, periodo == p)
  det_br <- det |> group_by(periodo) |> summarise(across(c(notif, conf, lab, pa), sum)) |>
    mutate(tx_notif = 1e5 * notif / pa, pct_conf = 100 * conf / notif, pct_lab = 100 * lab / conf, tx_clin = 1e5 * (conf - lab) / pa, tx_lab = 1e5 * lab / pa)
  B <- function(p) det_br |> filter(periodo == p) }
tem_onda <- ex("momento_onda_regiao.csv"); if (tem_onda) onda <- rd("momento_onda_regiao.csv")
# ESF < 50%: participação nos nascidos vivos e capitais
tem_apsp <- file.exists("dados/processados/aps_mun.rds") && file.exists("dados/processados/cobertura_mun.rds")
if (tem_apsp) {
  CAPS <- c("110020","130260","120040","150140","160030","140010","172100","211130","221100","230440","240810","250750","261160",
            "270430","280030","292740","310620","320530","330455","355030","410690","420540","431490","500270","510340","520870","530010")
  ap <- readRDS("dados/processados/aps_mun.rds") |> inner_join(readRDS("dados/processados/cobertura_mun.rds") |> select(code_muni, nv_1923), by = "code_muni")
  ap_lt50 <- ap |> summarise(pct_nv = 100 * sum(nv_1923[cat_aps == "< 50%"], na.rm = TRUE) / sum(nv_1923, na.rm = TRUE),
                             cap = sum(cat_aps == "< 50%" & substr(as.character(code_muni), 1, 6) %in% CAPS))
}
# subdetecção no Norte e no Nordeste (06d)
tem_sub <- tem_det && ex("subdeteccao_magnitude.csv") && ex("subdeteccao_modelos.csv")
if (tem_sub) { smg <- rd("subdeteccao_magnitude.csv"); smd <- rd("subdeteccao_modelos.csv")
  C_INV <- "Investigação no nível de 2016–2019"; C_SSE <- "Mesma variação do Sul e do Sudeste"
  SK <- function(cen, r) smg |> filter(ano == 9999, cenario == cen, regiao == r) |> transmute(k, excesso, rr = oe, lo, hi)
  SA <- function(cen, comp, e = "Não vacinados 2019–2023") smd |> filter(ano_alvo == 9999, cenario == cen, comparacao == comp, exposicao == e) }

# cobertura e excesso: estimativa principal = efeitos fixos de município e de região x ano
dl_e <- M("6m_4a", EXD, "e_continua_regiao_ano"); nv_e <- M("6m_4a", EXN, "e_continua_regiao_ano"); tp_e <- M("lt_6m", EXT, "e_continua_regiao_ano")
dl_d <- M("6m_4a", EXD, "d_continua"); nv_d <- M("6m_4a", EXN, "d_continua")
dl_a <- M("6m_4a", EXD, "a_rr_categoria"); nv_a <- M("6m_4a", EXN, "a_rr_categoria"); tp_a <- M("lt_6m", EXT, "a_rr_categoria")
cat_txt <- function(x) paste0(tolower(x$termo), " (RR ", icx(x), ")", collapse = "; ")
nv_assoc <- sig(nv_e$lo, nv_e$hi) && nv_e$irr > 1; dl_assoc <- sig(dl_e$lo, dl_e$hi) && dl_e$irr > 1
tp_assoc <- sig(tp_e$lo, tp_e$hi) && tp_e$irr > 1
inverso_nacional <- isTRUE(nv_d$hi < 1) | isTRUE(dl_d$hi < 1)
nv_jd <- MJ("jul_dez_2024", "6m_4a", EXN); tp_jd <- MJ("jul_dez_2024", "lt_6m", EXT)
nv_2425 <- MJ("ano_2024_2025", "6m_4a", EXN); tp_2425 <- MJ("ano_2024_2025", "lt_6m", EXT)
nv_24 <- MJ("ano_2024", "6m_4a", EXN); tp_24 <- MJ("ano_2024", "lt_6m", EXT)
nv25 <- MJ("ano_2025", "6m_4a", EXN); dl25 <- MJ("ano_2025", "6m_4a", EXD); tp25 <- MJ("ano_2025", "lt_6m", EXT)
tem_sl <- ex("sensibilidade_laboratorio.csv")
if (tem_sl) { sl <- rd("sensibilidade_laboratorio.csv") |> filter(desfecho == "Confirmados por laboratório")
  SL <- function(e) sl |> filter(exposicao == e) }
tem_atr <- ex("casos_atribuiveis_2024.csv")
if (tem_atr) { atr <- rd("casos_atribuiveis_2024.csv"); AT <- function(gr) atr |> filter(grupo == gr) }

# atenção primária
tem_aps <- ex("modelos_aps.csv") && ex("aps_resumo.csv")
if (tem_aps) {
  ar <- rd("aps_resumo.csv"); ma_all <- rd("modelos_aps.csv"); ma <- ma_all |> filter(ano_alvo == JP)
  A <- function(gr, e, mo, te = NULL) { y <- ma |> filter(grupo == gr, exposicao == e, modelo == mo); if (!is.null(te)) y <- y |> filter(termo == te); y }
  int_dl <- A("6m_4a", EXD, "g_interacao", "interacao"); int_nv <- A("6m_4a", EXN, "g_interacao", "interacao")
  int_tp <- A("lt_6m", EXT, "g_interacao", "interacao"); int_lab <- A("6m_4a", EXN, "g_interacao_lab", "interacao")
  cond <- function(a) A("6m_4a", EXN, "g_efeito_condicional", paste0("APS ", a, "%"))
  aps_i <- A("6m_4a", EXD, "i_aps"); AI <- function(k) aps_i |> filter(termo == k)
  modifica <- any(c(int_dl$p, int_nv$p, int_tp$p) < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
  AIJ <- function(j, k) ma_all |> filter(ano_alvo == j, grupo == "6m_4a", exposicao == EXD, modelo == "i_aps", termo == k)
  tem_ec <- ex("esf_cobertura_vacinal.csv") && ex("esf_cobertura_por_categoria.csv")
  if (tem_ec) { ecv <- rd("esf_cobertura_vacinal.csv"); ecc <- rd("esf_cobertura_por_categoria.csv")
    EV <- function(y) ecv |> filter(desfecho == y) |> slice(1); EC <- function(r, k) ecc |> filter(regiao == r, cat_aps == k) }
  tem_med <- ex("mediacao_esf.csv"); if (tem_med) { med <- rd("mediacao_esf.csv"); MD <- function(e) med |> filter(efeito == e) |> transmute(irr, lo = irr_lo, hi = irr_hi) }
} else { tem_ec <- tem_med <- FALSE }
```


# Supplementary material

**Pertussis resurgence in children under five years in Brazil, 2024–2025: magnitude, laboratory confirmation, vaccination and primary health care**

```{r tabs1}
JN <- c(principal = "Jul 2024–Dec 2025 (main)", ano_2024_2025 = "2024–2025", jul_dez_2024 = "Jul–Dec 2024", ano_2024 = "Year 2024", ano_2025 = "Year 2025")
rr_cel <- function(r, l, h) paste0(f(r, 2), " (", f(l, 2), "–", f(h, 2), ")")
rot <- c(`< 5 anos` = "Total, < 5 years", lt_6m = "< 6 months", `6_11m` = "6–11 months", `1_4a` = "1–4 years",
         Sul = "South", Sudeste = "Southeast", `Centro-Oeste` = "Center-West", Nordeste = "Northeast", Norte = "North",
         lab = "Laboratory confirmation", nlab = "Clinical confirmation")
ts1 <- purrr::map_dfr(names(JN), function(j) RRJ(j) |> mutate(janela = JN[[j]], v = rr_cel(rr, lo, hi))) |>
  mutate(Category = ifelse(nivel %in% names(rot), rot[nivel], nivel)) |>
  select(Category, janela, v) |> tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = janela, values_from = v)
flextable(ts1) |>
  set_caption("Table S1. Pertussis rate ratio (RR) in children under five years relative to the same months of 2016–2019, by analysis period, Brazil.") |>
  hline(i = c(4, 9), border = officer::fp_border(color = "grey60", width = .5)) |>
  bold(i = 1) |> align(j = -1, align = "center", part = "all") |>
  fontsize(size = 8, part = "all") |> autofit() |> fit_to_width(6.5) |>
  add_footer_lines("RR (95% CI): negative binomial regression with calendar month as the unit and adjustment for month of the year; each period is compared with the same months of 2016–2019. 2025 data are preliminary.") |>
  fontsize(size = 8, part = "footer")
```

```{r tabs2}
lin <- function(x, d = 2) if (is.null(x) || !nrow(x)) "—" else paste0(f(x$irr, d), " (", f(x$lo, d), "–", f(x$hi, d), ")")
ex3 <- c("6m_4a|Não vacinados 2019–2023" = "6 months–4 years: unvaccinated",
         "6m_4a|Variação da DTP" = "6 months–4 years: decline in DTP",
         "lt_6m|dTpa 2023–2024" = "< 6 months: lower maternal Tdap")
ts2 <- purrr::map_dfr(names(ex3), function(k) {
  gr <- sub("\\|.*", "", k); e <- sub(".*\\|", "", k)
  tibble(`Exposure (per 10 pp)` = ex3[[k]],
         !!!setNames(lapply(names(JN), function(j) lin(MJ(j, gr, e))), JN))
})
esf <- function(j) { x <- ma_all |> filter(ano_alvo == j, grupo == "6m_4a", exposicao == EXD, modelo == "i_aps", termo == "< 50%"); lin(x) }
ts2 <- bind_rows(ts2, tibble(`Exposure (per 10 pp)` = "6 months–4 years: FHS < 50% vs ≥ 80% (RR)",
                             !!!setNames(lapply(names(JN), esf), JN)))
flextable(ts2) |>
  set_caption("Table S2. Vaccination, Family Health Strategy (FHS) coverage and the increase in pertussis, comparing municipalities within the same region, by analysis period.") |>
  align(j = -1, align = "center", part = "all") |>
  fontsize(size = 8, part = "all") |> autofit() |> fit_to_width(6.5) |>
  add_footer_lines("RR (95% CI): how many times larger the increase in cases relative to 2016–2019 was per 10 percentage points (pp) of exposure; in the last row, ratio between the increase in municipalities with FHS coverage < 50% and ≥ 80%. Poisson regression with municipality and region × period fixed effects, population offset and standard errors clustered by municipality.") |>
  fontsize(size = 8, part = "footer")
```

```{r s1, fig.cap = "Fig. S1. Monthly pertussis rate ratio in 2024 and 2025 (preliminary data) relative to 2016–2019, in children under five years and by age group. The ratio exceeded 1 in July 2024, the start of the epidemic circulation that delimits the analysis period. Negative binomial regression with an interaction between period and month; bars: 95% confidence intervals.", out.width = "100%"}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(FIG, "fig3_rr_mensal_2024.png"))
```

```{r s2, fig.cap = "Fig. S2. Pertussis incidence (cases per 100,000 person-years) by age group in 2016–2019 (annual mean), July 2024 to December 2025 (analysis period) and calendar years 2024 and 2025 (preliminary data). Bars: exact 95% confidence intervals.", out.width = "80%"}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(FIG, "clin2_incidencia_faixa.png"))
```

```

```{r s6, eval = tem_aps, fig.cap = "Fig. S6. Did Family Health Strategy (FHS) coverage modify the effect of non-vaccination on the increase in cases from July 2024 to December 2025? A: rate ratio of the increase per 10 percentage points (pp) of unvaccinated children, decline in DTP coverage or pregnant women without Tdap, in each FHS category (n: number of municipalities), with the p value for interaction. B: increase in each combination of change in DTP coverage and FHS coverage in children aged 6 months to 4 years, relative to municipalities without a decline in DTP and with FHS coverage ≥ 80%.
